00060 class Interceptor : public Component
00061 {
00062 public:
00063  Interceptor(Component* _owner, const bool _constrain = false) 
00064  : owner(_owner),
00065   mouseIsOver(0),
00066   mouseIsDownOn(0),
00067   constrain(_constrain)
00068  { 
00069   setInterceptsMouseClicks(true, true);
00070  }
00071  
00072  void mouseEnter (const MouseEvent& e)
00073  {
00074   ScopedIgnoreMouse m(this);
00075   mouseMove(e);
00076  }
00077  
00078  void mouseExit (const MouseEvent& e)
00079  {
00080   ScopedIgnoreMouse m(this);
00081   
00082   if(mouseIsDownOn)
00083    mouseIsDownOn->mouseUp(e.getEventRelativeTo(mouseIsDownOn));
00084   
00085   mouseIsDownOn = 0;
00086   
00087   if(mouseIsOver)
00088    mouseIsOver->mouseExit(e.getEventRelativeTo(mouseIsOver));
00089   
00090   mouseIsOver = 0;
00091  }
00092  
00093  void mouseMove (const MouseEvent& e)
00094  {
00095   ScopedIgnoreMouse m(this);
00096   
00097   Component *comp = owner->getComponentAt(e.x, e.y);
00098   
00099   if(comp == mouseIsOver)
00100   {
00101    if(mouseIsOver)
00102     mouseIsOver->mouseMove(e.getEventRelativeTo(mouseIsOver));
00103   }
00104   else
00105   {
00106    if(mouseIsOver)
00107     mouseIsOver->mouseExit(e.getEventRelativeTo(mouseIsOver));
00108    
00109    mouseIsOver = comp;
00110    
00111    if(mouseIsOver)
00112     mouseIsOver->mouseEnter(e.getEventRelativeTo(mouseIsOver));
00113   }
00114  }
00115  
00116  void mouseDown (const MouseEvent& e)
00117  {
00118   ScopedIgnoreMouse m(this);
00119   
00120   if(mouseIsOver)
00121   {
00122    mouseIsDownOn = mouseIsOver;
00123    mouseIsDownOn->mouseDown(e.getEventRelativeTo(mouseIsDownOn));
00124    
00125    lastDragX = e.x;
00126    lastDragY = e.y;
00127   }
00128  }
00129  
00130  void mouseUp (const MouseEvent& e)
00131  {
00132   ScopedIgnoreMouse m(this);
00133   
00134   if(mouseIsDownOn)
00135   {
00136    mouseIsDownOn->mouseUp(e.getEventRelativeTo(mouseIsDownOn));
00137    mouseIsDownOn = 0;
00138   }
00139  }
00140  
00141  void mouseDrag (const MouseEvent& e)
00142  {
00143   ScopedIgnoreMouse m(this);
00144   
00145   Component *comp = owner->getComponentAt(e.x, e.y);
00146   
00147   if(comp == mouseIsDownOn)
00148   {
00149    if(mouseIsDownOn)
00150     mouseIsDownOn->mouseDrag(e.getEventRelativeTo(mouseIsDownOn));
00151   }
00152   else
00153   {
00154    int deltaX = e.x - lastDragX;
00155    int deltaY = e.y - lastDragY;
00156    double incX, incY;
00157    int steps;
00158    
00159    if(deltaX == 0)
00160    {
00161     incX = 0;
00162     incY = e.y > lastDragY ? 1.0 : -1.0;
00163     steps = std::abs(deltaY);
00164    }
00165    else if(deltaY == 0)
00166    {
00167     incX = e.x > lastDragX ? 1.0 : -1.0;
00168     incY = 0;
00169     steps = std::abs(deltaX);
00170    }
00171    else if(std::abs(deltaX) > std::abs(deltaY))
00172    {
00173     incX = e.x > lastDragX ? 1.0 : -1.0;;
00174     incY = (double)deltaY / std::abs(deltaX);
00175     steps = std::abs(deltaX);
00176    }
00177    else
00178    {
00179     incX = (double)deltaX / std::abs(deltaY);
00180     incY = e.y > lastDragY ? 1.0 : -1.0;
00181     steps = std::abs(deltaY);
00182    }
00183    
00184    double x = lastDragX;
00185    double y = lastDragY;
00186       
00187    while(steps--)
00188    {
00189     MouseEvent eventCopy = e.withNewPosition(Point<int>(constrain ? jlimit(1, getWidth()-2, (int)x) : (int)x, 
00190                  constrain ? jlimit(1, getHeight()-2, (int)y) : (int)y));
00191         
00192     Component *comp = owner->getComponentAt(eventCopy.x, eventCopy.y);
00193     if(comp == mouseIsDownOn)
00194     {
00195      if(mouseIsDownOn)
00196       mouseIsDownOn->mouseDrag(eventCopy.getEventRelativeTo(mouseIsDownOn));
00197     }
00198     else
00199     {
00200      if(mouseIsDownOn)
00201      {
00202       mouseIsDownOn->mouseUp(eventCopy.getEventRelativeTo(mouseIsDownOn));
00203       mouseIsDownOn->mouseExit(eventCopy.getEventRelativeTo(mouseIsDownOn));
00204      }
00205      
00206      mouseIsDownOn = comp;
00207      
00208      if(mouseIsDownOn)
00209      {
00210       mouseIsDownOn->mouseEnter(eventCopy.getEventRelativeTo(mouseIsDownOn));
00211       mouseIsDownOn->mouseDown(eventCopy.getEventRelativeTo(mouseIsDownOn));
00212      }
00213     }
00214     
00215     x += incX;
00216     y += incY;
00217    }
00218   }
00219   
00220   lastDragX = e.x;
00221   lastDragY = e.y;
00222  } 
00223  
00224 private:
00225  Component* const owner;
00226  Component* mouseIsOver;
00227  Component* mouseIsDownOn;
00228  int lastDragX, lastDragY;
00229  bool constrain;
00230 };

00233 class MultiSliderBase : public Component
00234 {
00235 public:
00236  MultiSliderBase(const int numSliders = 1, 
00237      const bool canDragAcross = true, 
00238      const bool slidersAreHorizontal = true,
00239      const double sliderMinimum = 0.0,
00240      const double sliderMaximum = 1.0) throw()
00241  : interceptor(0), horizontal(true)
00242  {
00243   setNumSlidersInternal(numSliders, canDragAcross, slidersAreHorizontal);
00244  }
00245  
00246  ~MultiSliderBase()
00247  {
00248   deleteAllChildren();
00249  }
00250  
00251  
00252  int getNumSliders() const throw() { return sliders.size(); }
00253 
00254  void setNumSliders(const int numSliders, 
00255         const bool canDragAcross = true,
00256         const bool slidersAreHorizontal = true,
00257         const double sliderMinimum = 0.0,
00258         const double sliderMaximum = 1.0) throw()
00259  {
00260   setNumSlidersInternal(numSliders, canDragAcross, slidersAreHorizontal, 
00261          sliderMinimum, sliderMaximum);
00262   resized();
00263  }
00264  
00265  void setNumSlidersInternal(const int numSliders, 
00266           const bool canDragAcross = true,
00267           const bool slidersAreHorizontal = true,
00268           const double sliderMinimum = 0.0,
00269           const double sliderMaximum = 1.0) throw()
00270  {
00271   if(numSliders != sliders.size())
00272   {
00273    deleteAllChildren();
00274    sliders.clear();
00275    interceptor = 0;
00276    
00277    horizontal = slidersAreHorizontal;
00278    
00279    for(int i = 0; i < numSliders; i++)
00280    {
00281     Slider *slider = new Slider(String("Multislider")+String(i));
00282     slider->setSliderStyle(horizontal ? Slider::LinearHorizontal : Slider::LinearVertical);
00283     slider->setTextBoxStyle(Slider::NoTextBox, 0,0,0);
00284     slider->setRange(sliderMinimum, sliderMaximum, 0.0);
00285     addAndMakeVisible(slider);
00286     sliders.add(slider);
00287    }
00288    
00289    if(canDragAcross)
00290     addAndMakeVisible(interceptor = new Interceptor(this, true));
00291    
00292    return;
00293   }
00294   
00295   if(canDragAcross == true && interceptor == 0)
00296   {
00297    addAndMakeVisible(interceptor = new Interceptor(this, true));
00298   }
00299   else if(canDragAcross == false && interceptor != 0)
00300   {
00301    removeChildComponent(interceptor);
00302    deleteAndZero(interceptor);
00303   }
00304   
00305   if(slidersAreHorizontal != horizontal)
00306   {
00307    horizontal = slidersAreHorizontal;
00308    
00309    for(int i = 0; i < sliders.size(); i++)
00310    {
00311     sliders[i]->setSliderStyle(horizontal ? Slider::LinearHorizontal : Slider::LinearVertical);
00312    }
00313   }
00314   
00315  }
00316  
00317  void setRange(const double newMinimum,
00318       const double newMaximum,
00319       const double newInterval = 0) 
00320  {
00321   for(int i = 0; i < sliders.size(); i++)
00322   {
00323    sliders[i]->setRange(newMinimum, newMaximum, newInterval);
00324   }
00325  }
00326  
00327  void resized()
00328  {
00329   if(interceptor)
00330    interceptor->setBounds(0, 0, getWidth(), getHeight());
00331   
00332   if(horizontal)
00333   {
00334    const float sliderHeight = (float)getHeight() / sliders.size();
00335    float y = 0.f;
00336    for(int i = 0; i < sliders.size(); i++)
00337    {
00338     sliders[i]->setBounds(0, roundFloatToInt(y), getWidth(), sliderHeight);
00339     y += sliderHeight;
00340    }
00341   }
00342   else
00343   {
00344    const float sliderWidth = (float)getWidth() / sliders.size();
00345    float x = 0.f;
00346    for(int i = 0; i < sliders.size(); i++)
00347    {
00348     sliders[i]->setBounds(roundFloatToInt(x), 0, sliderWidth, getHeight());
00349     x += sliderWidth;
00350    }
00351   }
00352  }

00357  }

00363  }
